scope: Exact one-prime reciprocity obstruction for an explicitly non-section tuple; this is not a counterexample to a section theorem.
all_other_invariants: 0, because the first Hilbert-symbol entry is 1; this includes the real place.
integrality: The points are integral on P1 minus {0,1,2,infinity} outside {2,3}; this follows from 3*(3-1)*(3-2)=6.
conclusion: No global squareclass has precisely these localizations.
